verses.text: Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that sittest in the heavens.

segments.text: Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes,
O thou that sittest in the heavens.

verses.text: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maid unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes look unto Jehovah our God, Until he have mercy upon us.

segments.text: Behold, as the eyes of servants
unto the hand of their master,
As the eyes of a maid unto the hand of her mistress;
Until he have mercy upon us.

verses.text: Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah, have mercy upon us; For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

segments.text: Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah, have mercy upon us;
For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

verses.text: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scoffing of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud.

segments.text: With the scoffing of those that are at ease,
And with the contempt of the proud.
